## Four complete new results

- **Physical-two West/strict roofs:** the entire same strict-hub-axis AD feature is excluded by a unit-chord identity and two continuous support/torque inequalities. The separate whole positive-length shared perpendicular AD feature is excluded using both full unloaded hub moments and an actual point of the exterior square. Every original shared mean and both individual-zero physical circle-coefficient endpoints remain.
- **Unique-circle Type III:** a radius-free full-star lemma excludes both genuine sole perpendicular AD owners, each proved separately in the unchanged upper/lower chart. The surviving owned domain has exactly four same-axis/shared rows, with all original force and moment formulas, full closed shared means and simultaneous actual-point circle constraints. Its whole angle domain is `pi/2<=alpha+beta<2pi/3`, with `beta>pi/4`. These four rows remain open.
- **Three-genuine-root triangles:** the entire nonparallel pair at a true3 middle root is excluded when each outer root has all external neighbors physically boundary at arbitrary degree, or exactly one true2 external neighbor. The new complete true4 moment keeps the original negative interface coordinate and forces an unloaded true2 continuation to demand actual support above `59/36>d). Actual-point and real-leaf center bounds complete the exclusion.
- **Literal house/fan transfer:** house ADT keeps true A4/D4/T3/B2/C2 and fan H12 keeps H5/1_3/2_4/3_3/4_2. Their whole nonparallel middle features and parallel/both-outer-owned features are excluded. Their parallel/tilted alternatives remain at this checkpoint.

All four sources and all four separate full independent reviews were read completely by root. Root reconstructed every new original equation, geometry, physical-mask endpoint and caller. Verification includes **37 matching named source-table pin occurrences, 25 matching current-row inline pins, 29 positive exact rational comparisons and six exact scalar identities**.

The immutable tree changes exactly **15 allowlisted paths**, with every expected Git blob hash verified, no extra paths and no deletions. All five metadata edits reverse exactly to the previous hashes after removing the new header and reverting the six named prose-only row updates. Both complete ordered original flag arrays are unchanged.

The earlier unique-triangle owner assembly retains its explicitly assumed prior nonempty OPEN common domain. These new results add no selector, repair no missing global compatibility premise and do not alter an extracted certificate. All nine actual units, original positive forces, true degrees, selected normals, full shared means, physical circle masks and individual zero coefficients remain.

Hand proofs only. No Lean/Lake build, CI/workflow dispatch, numerical pose search, angle mesh, new packing certificate or merge.

## Complete new uniform results

### Three real S-leaf roots with small vertices have capacity at most eight

The [complete physical theorem](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/6df53a5d35dd45ae1c851d0a8b384f9ff27ff554/research/nine/THREE_REAL_S_LEAF_ROOTS_WITH_TWO_EPSILON_VERTICES_NINE_UNIT_EXCLUSION_2026_10_29.md) excludes a nine-unit packing whenever EACH of three actual real S-leaf roots has an actual vertex of norm at most `2epsilon`. It keeps arbitrary root degrees and every original physical unit. The complete high-S reduction supplies the full original low/critical/D cover before this high-radius case.

Its proof derives the actual root charts and adds nine disjoint occupied circle pieces: three root arcs, three full real-leaf arcs and three actual completion components. An exact angle-sum argument makes their total exceed a full circle. The final rational cosine reserve is `1173673/200000000`.

A surviving three-genuine-root configuration must therefore have some root with **no** vertex within `2epsilon`. The older result giving two vertices within `4epsilon` does not supply the new theorem's three-vertex premise.

### Three near units force uniform arcs for all six other actual units

The [complete companion theorem](https://github.com/vltanh/lean4-squares-in-circles/blob/6df53a5d35dd45ae1c851d0a8b384f9ff27ff554/research/nine/THREE_NEAR_UNITS_COMPLETION_CENTER_COMPONENT_ARCS_AND_REAL_S_LEAF_BUDGET_2026_10_29.md) uses no force equation or degree assumption. In any actual nine-unit collection with three units meeting the closed radius-`1/60` disk, every other center exceeds `6577/10000`, every other unit has strict clearance greater than `1/60`, and every center component on the radius-`9/8` circle has length greater than `acos(9/10)`. At least five of those six components exceed forty degrees.

For three real S leaves, at least two of the three other actual squares exceed forty degrees, and the third exceeds `acos(9/10)`. The exact full leaf halfwidth is `min(acos(d/(9/8)), asin(4/9))`. Full disconnected intersections remain; the theorem supplies a root-measure budget and actual connected-component gap routing.

### Unique-circle triangles have a complete owner reduction

The full three-port classification and complete Type-I join give an actual side owner on **every triangle edge AV, DV and AD** throughout the genuine unique-V domain at the stated common initial selection.

The new fourth finite dense family is imposed jointly with the preceding three **before extraction**, inside the same explicitly assumed prior nonempty OPEN admissible domain. All old nondense restrictions, physical predicates and genuine matched parameters remain. This conditional local argument does not establish the missing global prior compatibility audit or alter an already extracted certificate.

Every original roof/interface shared mean remains. The owned triangle geometry, full exterior stars and all three actual completion squares remain obligations.

### Physical-two roofs have complete application and free/shared exclusions

All five original applications are now proved pairwise distinct. A separate selection-free support theorem excludes the **entire one-free/one-shared roof feature**, including every shift, the full closed shared-mean interval, both whole-side endpoint geometries and both individual-zero circle-coefficient endpoints.

The two physical corners remain physically present even when one coefficient is zero. Both remaining inner-face charts retain their singleton/owned alternatives; a unique-circle fixed-tip selector is not applied to them.

All nine actual squares, original positive forces, true degrees, actual normals, full shared means, physical circle masks and individual zero coefficients remain. D02 keeps full unloaded A3/D3, loaded V2/B2/C2, N unloaded in L135 and loaded in L1345, and all three completion squares.
